headline: Fire Crew joins the trainable shelf — the crew records itself
lede: PLAICRAFT's ninth game can now learn from real humans: consented phone runs of Fire Crew land in the research store as replay-verified takes with 65 seat-sense features per tick, aligned radio audio, and honest bookkeeping for the watch seat. Jon also promoted three flagships to public.

notes.text: Fire Crew auto-capture: the consent gate goes up before the alarm, recordings open at seed-birth and replay-verify tick-for-tick; the radio yields its mic slot to the auto layer while recognition keeps running (#1712).
65 seat features where the game's own lightAt law is the model's eyes — a victim the smoke hides stays an honest zero, and fire is shared because it glows through smoke, by rule.

The WATCH sheet hand-offs now travel inside the recording (rules.watch spans), so the dataset re-seats the autopilot exactly and never teaches its saves as a person's takes. Mutant-proven: adapter bypass, view-widening leaks and tampered checkpoints all die by name.
Jon's decision on #2846 shipped: CONTRA, DOUBLE DRAGON and R-TYPE are tagged public behind an allowlist gate that refuses any other auto-promotion.

look.text: R-TYPE is public per Jon's call — fly the S.E.E.D. pod on the shelf
